item.title: Ann Godoff, Penguin Press Founder and Editor, Dies at 76
item.description: Ann Godoff, an editor and publisher for Penguin Press, died on Feb. 24 in Albany, N.Y. She was 76. Godoff died from complications of bone cancer in a hospital, her partner, Annik LaFarge confirmed to the New York Times.
